summary: Moody voted no in July 2025 on two resolutions that would have blocked arms transfers to Israel and co-sponsored the Stand with Israel Act in May 2025 to cut U.S. funding to UN agencies restricting Israel's participation. Her campaign also claims a Republican Jewish Coalition endorsement. These documented legislative actions and endorsement reflect a consistent pro-Israel record on the questions before her.
